title: BeautifulButtons
description: This project adds a new way to make your minecraft feel like your own!
body:
# 🎨 BeautifulButtons  

Give your Minecraft buttons a makeover — because your UI deserves a little personality.  

BeautifulButtons is a client-side mod that lets you customise the colour of every button in Minecraft's menus. Pick any hex colour you like, or choose from a built-in palette of 12 presets — then preview your choice live before applying it.  


## ✨ Features:  


Full hex colour support — enter any valid hex code to get the exact colour you want  
12 quick-pick presets — red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, grey, dark grey, and black  
Live preview — see exactly what your button will look like before committing  
Per-button customisation — colour individual buttons differently for a truly unique UI  
Reset at any time — one click to go back to default  

## How to use it:  

Once the mod is installed, open the colour settings for any button from the options menu. Type in a hex code (like #2ECC71 for green), or click one of the preset swatches. The preview at the bottom of the screen updates instantly. Hit Apply when you're happy, Reset to go back to default, or Cancel to exit without saving.
